title: Plot cumulative reward and regret
description: You display two views of the stored strategy reward sequences.

steps.description: You visit each labeled result and plot its running reward sum. Each curve comes from out[rewards] in res.
You label the first chart Cumulative Reward with Round on the horizontal axis. The legend preserves the result labels.

steps.question: What baseline does the regret curve use at round r?
steps.answer: It uses best_mu*r, then subtracts the realized reward accumulated through that round. np.arange starts the baseline at round one.

steps.description: You plot those regret sequences in a second figure. Both charts use the same stored runs; the supplied output gives no numeric curve values.
